QuestInfo.name: [Lachelein] Dream Within a Dream
QuestInfo.0: Write a letter to send to the Alliance about the information on the Arcane River obtained in Lachelein. You can make the letter into a paper boat to float on the #bcalm water#k in #bLachelein Canal#k.
QuestInfo.1: The paper boat traveled far up the river of Lachelein. ...Will this paper boat reach the Alliance? It would be great if it did...
